notes.title: Version 1.6406
Major Update! Build 1.3301
Update 1.3110 April 22, 2025
New Airport Alert: Las Vegas International!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31284389/33f8fea2fe0be34809639d818da668c3cf9d1827.jpg[/img]


[h1] Las Vegas International Airport[/h1] 

[list]
    [*]Four Runways
    [*]8 Gates
    [*]Parallel Runway Configuration
    [*]Crossing Runway Conflicts
[/list] 

Las Vegas Airport is definitely one of the higher-stress airfields offered in the Airport Madness series.  Strive to move air traffic as quickly as possible, by timing your takeoffs strategically, and redirecting landing aircraft to runways with the least air conflicts!

notes.title: Airport Madness 3D Update 1.3091: Larger explosions and improved visuals!
notes.content:
We've added a bunch to both volumes of Airport Madness 3D.  While we do plan to add more fields soon, for now we've sharpened up the aircraft models to have a higher level of detail.  All airports have been given more buildings, better trees, more static vehicles, including static aircraft.  

The explosions are what we are most proud of.  Some may call it unrealistic, but dang.  The explosion is huge.  Lots more shrapnel, smoke, flames, and even flying ragdoll bodies can be seen.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31284389/f38721b7ddabfdd7bad92f3a05f2d905c3029689.jpg[/img]

We think you will appreciate this update :)

notes.title: Update 1.010 Available Now!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing the second volume of Airport Madness 3D.  Since the initial launch two days ago, a few issues have appeared.  Today we've done the following:


[list]
  [*]Reduced file size and minor performance improvement
  [*]Resolved JFK non-responsive aircraft issue
 [*]London City 09 departures tagged incorrectly as '27'.
[*]Improved view from the cockpit at Lukla, Nepal
[*]Fixed traffic jam at Lukla, Nepal
[*]Added fog to rainy weather option
[/list] 

We hope you will leave us your honest feedback on the Steam product purchase page.
